title: MoonStar
description: Step into a world of beauty, adventure and a touch of magic in this Content-Rich modpack!
body:
If your looking for a modpack that has beauty, magic, monsters and unique mods that set it apart from the rest than look no furthur than MoonStar!

**Features**

-Overhauled World Gen (Biomes O' Plenty, Terralith)

-Qol Features (Graves, Zoom)

-All The Furniture you could ever want!

-Magic

-Extra Dimensions (Aether, Bumblezone)

-300+ Mods

**Performance**

Due to the large nature of this modpack please allocate atleast 10GB+ of memory.
